answers.text: 'Pressing its high on D and H1.' A 20-day high is not my new high: W sits 6.3% under its 20-wk high and from_52w_hi -15.14 is not a new high out of a sound base (C7). day_vol 1.3 under 1.40 is a hard rejection (C16), and group rank fifth fails C9. Volume is my test even if not theirs. Claim stands.

'Off-the-high is a weekly range read.' Yes, and I judge the base on the weekly: W 6.3% under the 20-wk high, from_52w_hi -15.14. A daily range exit (D 0.42% under) inside a weekly range is not a C7 new high, and day_vol 1.3 fails C16. Group rank is my C9 test. Claim stands.

'20-wk high overhead is the pivotal point to clear.' Agreed it is the level to clear: W 5.0% under the 20-wk high, from_52w_hi -4.63, so the new high has not printed. My claim was C9: Staples rank 114 behind KDP, CHD, MDLZ. The sympathy name is the trade I am told not to take. Claim stands.

'Overhead supply is my first target, not a reason against.' For a base-reader overhead supply 5.0% above (W) is exactly what a sound pivot must clear (C7). D HH/HL 0.3% under is a daily break, not a weekly one. Group rank fails C9 regardless of the grid. Claim stands.

'Volume 1.24 is above average.' Above average is not +40% above it: 1.24 under 1.40 is a hard rejection on my test (C16). The grid shows a leader at its high (W 0.5%, D 0.5% under), which I granted. Group rank fourth fails C9. Extension I weigh as context only. Claim stands.

'Extension sets entry location, never a reason against.' For me distance past the pivot is a rule (C17), but I concede sma_distance_pct is context, not the pivot test, so extension is not my basis. day_vol 1.24 under 1.40 (C16) and fourth in group (C9) still fail; H1 LH/LL adds no volume. Claim stands.

'Group leadership is not my test.' It is mine: C9 buys the No.1-3 in the group, and VRTX sits behind EW in Healthcare. D 2.7% under its 20-day high and H1 below EMA9 at 39% of range show no fresh breakout now. day_vol 2.3 passed, which I granted. Claim stands.

'Weak down day is the first pullback my family buys.' Buying a retracement is not my method; I buy a pivot breakout from a base on volume. W HH/HL is intact, but D 2.73% under the high and H1 below EMA9 is no new high, and the C9 group-rank failure is untouched. Claim stands.

'A base read is not my entry.' It is mine: R3 says no sound base, no pivot. lens coil, leadership and insti_money are '--', so I cannot certify a base. The grid shows trend at the high (W, D 0.7% under), which is not a base. Industrials rank 14 fails C9. Claim stands.

'Structure is readable top-down as trend.' A trend of W and D HH/HL is not a measurable consolidation; C12-C14 need a base and a pivot, and coil is '--'. I accept sma_distance_pct is context, not my basis. C9 rank and R3 still fail. Claim stands.

'A volume cut-off is not my test.' It is mine, and it is hard: C16 says a breakout under +40% above average is a rejection, not a softer buy. day_vol 1.34 is under 1.40. The grid (W HH/HL 0.7% under, H1 96% of range) shows price strength I already granted. Claim stands.

'Group rank and coil are not my tests.' Both are mine: Staples rank 221 fails C9, lens coil '--' leaves R3 unread, and day_vol 1.36 under 1.40 fails C16. The grid (W 0.4%, D 0.4% under, H1 81% of range) shows a new high I granted, not a confirmed one. Claim stands.

'Stack is ordered on every frame.' The EMA9/21 stack is ordered on W, D and H1; my flat-stack point was ma_50 88.21 under ma_100 88.6, a slower read. I accept the faster stack is up. Group rank (C9) and coil warn (R3) are untouched, and D 2.6% under is no new high. Claim stands.

'The stack is not flat on my grid.' True on EMA9/21 (W 89.2131 > 87.8866, D 91.3154 > 89.5458); my point was ma_50 under ma_100. A shallow pullback 2.6% under the high is not a breakout from a base. C9 rank and lens coil warn still fail my test. Claim stands.

'Divergence is advisory only on my card.' On mine div_state is a menu field and a caution under C25: a high the oscillators do not confirm. W 1.2% under the 20-wk high shows the high, not its confirmation. Healthcare rank 109 fails C9 regardless. Claim stands.

'cmf 0.19 above zero, bullish.' cmf is not on my menu and not my test. div BEARISH/2 at a new high is a C25 caution I read. D HH/HL with no failure of the break is granted, but Healthcare rank 109 fails C9 and lens coil warn leaves R3 open. Claim stands.

'Not off the high on my frames.' Partly fair: W and D sit 0.6% under their 20-bar highs, so it is near a 20-week high. But from_52w_hi -7.13 is not a new 52-week high (C7), day_vol 1.16 fails C16 and Industrials rank 35 fails C9. Claim stands.

'Off the 52-week high is not a fault.' For CAN SLIM a new high out of a sound base is the buy (C7); -7.13 is not it. ret_63d and rs_rank_pct are not my L test. day_vol 1.16 under 1.40 (C16) and rank 35 behind HAYW, UPS, VLTO (C9) stand on the grid. Claim stands.

'Extension from the average is not distance from the high.' Correct, and my own R5 says sma_distance_pct is context, not the pivot test; I drop extension as a point. W and D HH/HL 0.9% under the high stands. day_vol 1.35 under 1.40 (C16) and rank 57 (C9) still fail. Claim stands.

'Coil and 52-week distance are not my buy test.' Both are mine: R3 needs a coil read (lens coil '--'), and C7 wants a new high, while W sits 5.6% under its 20-wk high. day_vol 1.22 under 1.40 is a hard C16 rejection. Claim stands.

'Quiet first pullback my retracement family buys.' A pullback is not my entry; I buy a pivot breakout on volume. D 2.6% under the high and H1 at 53% of range show no breakout, W 5.6% under shows no new high, and day_vol 1.22 fails C16. Claim stands.
